svg.title: From an excursion to a verified change
svg.desc: A proposed investigation workflow for process integration.
svg.text: From an excursion to a verified change
A proposed investigation workflow for process integration.
01 / CONFIRM
Validate the signal
Check test conditions, measurement repeatability and references
Establish what changed before interpreting a wafer map.
02 / SCOPE
Contain and compare
Group affected material by lot, wafer, tool, chamber and time
Compare with healthy material and review recent changes.
03 / CORRELATE
Connect the evidence
Align electrical data with inline measurements and tool history
A matching pattern supports a hypothesis; it does not prove a cause.
04 / TEST
Run a controlled split
Define the factor, baseline, response and acceptance criteria
Work with the process module to test the suspected mechanism.
05 / VERIFY
Check the trade-offs
Review electrical performance, yield and relevant reliability
Confirm repeatability across the intended process window.
If the evidence does not support the hypothesis, revisit the cause before changing the process.
